summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. filed a 6-K on 2026-08-27 containing a press release announcing a three-party memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Nanchang Institute of Science and Technology (NIST) and Intersect Holding. The MOU aims to build a Saudi-China education and technology platform, linking RYET, Intersect, and Wadi Makkah, with potential connections to Umm Al-Qura University and other Saudi institutions. No financial terms, share prices, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The filing is a routine announcement of a non-binding collaboration agreement, not a special-situation corporate event. What to watch: whether the MOU progresses to definitive agreements and potential revenue from the Formind strategy.
